_comment: Batch 1 (stage 27). One entry per mod: how it is carried and what is pruned. 'licence' is the Modrinth/jar label, not legal advice. 'publicRelease': false means the packed .hmod holds assets from the player's own jar and must never go into a public release or repository; the release-archive step filters on it. All numbers added by tools/batch1_content.py are estimates (see docs/batch1.md).

mods.name: Expanded Delight
mods.notes: Cooking and cutting recipes are consumed by the native Farmer's Delight pot and board (any namespace). Juicing recipes need the juicer block, which is not ported; botanypots recipes need a mod that is not in the port. Create recipe types stay: the loader decides.

mods.name: Farmer's Knives
mods.notes: 60 knives made from ingots of other mods; a knife stays only if its recipe items exist in the port (vanilla and carried namespaces). Stats are estimates.

mods.name: Mo Glass
mods.notes: 36 glass blocks, 72 recipes, tags. GPL: the assets come from the player's own jar and are not redistributed; behaviour (none) rebuilt from the public description.

mods.name: Perfect Homestead Plushies
mods.notes: All Rights Reserved. 53 plush blocks; their models use GeckoLib geo/animations in part, which the loader may skip (blocks fall back to their block model). Local use only.

mods.name: Spud's Shops
mods.notes: 43 blocks, 211 items, 209 recipes. Assets live under the namespace spudaciousshops while data lives under spuds_shops; the carry tool decides what it can join. Shop behaviour (if any) is not ported.

mods.name: Go Fish
mods.notes: Items, crates and recipes only. Catching the fish is Java (GoFishLoot, FishingBobber mixins, custom loot conditions): NOT ported, see docs/batch1.md.

mods.name: Nether's Delight (data half)
mods.notes: Dropped: the four furnace-like blocks (native stove/furnace behaviour needed), colonies and plants (growth), soils. Kept: foods, plates, meats, machetes (estimated stats), hoglin trophy and the cooking and cutting recipes.

mods.name: SparseStructures
mods.notes: No content in the jar (code and config only): shipped as a data pack datapacks/homestead-sparse generated from the player's own vanilla structure sets, spread factor from the Homestead config (1.2, mansion 2). New worlds only.
